typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		event_date as string,
		Late_Issued_MarginNotifications as integer,
		Call_status as integer,
		Percentage as decimal(10,2)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Loaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of Loaddate} = toString(Loaddate)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		Percentage as integer,
		call_Status as integer,
		Event_Date as string,
		Late_Issued_Margin_Notification as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate = {Copy of Loaddate},
		Percentage,
		call_Status = Call_status,
		Event_Date = event_date,
		Late_Issued_Margin_Notification = Late_Issued_MarginNotifications),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
